title: Base change of the integrated deformation comparison for a closed section
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ and a prime $\ell\ne p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. All schemes in this statement are separated and of finite type over $k$, and all morphisms are $k$-morphisms [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use the ordinary uncompleted constant-coefficient pro-etale module derived categories and their bounded constructible finite-Tor subcategories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Pullbacks and tensor products are the ordinary derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-tensor].
Put $R=\mathbf Z/\ell^r$, $r\ge1$. Let $g:V\to B$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], with a closed section $s:B\hookrightarrow V$, $gs=1$. Let $b:B'\to B$ be arbitrary, let $V'=V\times_BB'$, and write $g',s'$ for the pulled-back pair. Use $\omega_g=g_R^!R_B$ and $C_R(g,s)=s^*\omega_g$ [def-pur-section-invariant]. The comparison $c_s:b^*C_R(g,s)\xrightarrow{\sim}C_R(g',s')$ is pullback along $s'$ of the counit-defined exceptional exchange for $g$ [def-pur-co-smoothness].

Let $D_sV\to\mathbf A^1_B$ be the deformation family of [def-pur-dnc-section-family], let $\pi_N:N_s\to B$ be its rank-$d$ normal bundle with zero section $z$ [def-pur-normal-bundle], and use the primed versions over $B'$. The deformation families, their sections, punctured trivializations and fibers at $0,1$ are canonically identified by arbitrary base change; in particular $N_{s'}=N_s\times_BB'$. Let
$$\delta_{g,s}:C_R(g,s)\xrightarrow{\sim}z^*\omega_{\pi_N}$$
be the coordinate-normalized DNC comparison [thm-pur-dnc-invariance], and let $b_N:\omega_{\pi_N}\xrightarrow{\sim}R_{N_s}(d)[2d]$ be the integration-normalized vector-bundle orientation [cor-pur-vector-bundle-purity], with twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Define
$$\psi_{g,s}=z^*b_N\circ\delta_{g,s}:C_R(g,s)\xrightarrow{\sim}R_B(d)[2d].$$
Then, under the canonical Tate pullback identification,
$$\psi_{g',s'}\circ c_s=b^*\psi_{g,s}.$$
The comparison uses the actual normal bundle and the same normalized integration adjunction on it. It is valid for non-flat $b$, the rank-zero bundle and empty schemes. For the diagonal pair $g=p_1:X\times_YX\to X$, $s=\Delta$ of a smooth separated map $f:X\to Y$ of relative dimension $d$, let $b_f:p_2^*\omega_f\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_{p_1}$ be the counit-defined exceptional exchange of the Cartesian square $fp_1=fp_2$ and put $\kappa_f=\Delta^*b_f^{-1}:C_R(p_1,\Delta)\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_f$, using $p_2\Delta=1$ [lem-pur-diagonal-base-change]. Then the composite $\psi_{p_1,\Delta}\kappa_f^{-1}$ is the diagonal orientation $\omega_f\to R_X(d)[2d]$ of [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object], with the standard-coordinate normalization of [det-sp-orientation-charts].

proof.text: The normalized-base component of SectionRestriction.coherence, specialized to the given Cartesian pair and b, says baseComparison(sq) followed by delta_prime equals pullback(delta) followed by baseComparison(normalBaseChange(sq)).
Apply normalIntegration_baseChange to the same square to obtain compatibility of the second (normal-bundle integration) factor.

Unfold psi as delta followed by normalIntegration. Reassociate, substitute the two equations, and use Functor.mapIso_trans to obtain the claimed equality. This does not change the arbitrary-base-change, rank-zero or empty-scheme cases.

proof.text: For the diagonal pair choose the existing normalized purityTwistTransport. The normalIntegration_eq_sectionOrientation formula identifies its normal factor with chartDiagonalBeta. Global diagonal DNC assembly identifies the desired orientation with alpha inverse followed by chartDiagonalDelta and chartDiagonalBeta. Apply ExistsUnique.unique to the normalization proofs of the two chosen DNC maps to equate delta and chartDiagonalDelta. The result is associativity of Iso.trans.
